items.original_title: Trump's secret plane swap triggers questions and confusion
items.rss_summary:
A secret operation that reportedly smuggled Donald Trump off Air Force One in a catering truck before the plane departed carrying journalists and staff at apparent risk of an Iranian strike has raised questions over US security practices.  
            The Washington Post reported on Monday that Trump exited the presidential plane while it was on the ground in Turkey on July 8 as his security team deployed a scheme to evade an assassination threat.

items.original_title: Trump says Iran options are let Tehran fail economically or 'hit them really hard'
items.rss_summary: Aug 11 (Reuters) - U.S. President Donald Trump accused Iran of being "devious negotiators" in an interview released late on Monday and described some of his current options in the war — "just bop along" and let Tehran fail economically or hit them "really, really hard.""I'm sort of negotiating," Trump told Real America's Voice in a phone interview. "They're very devious negotiators."

items.title: RT от @WhiteHouse: Благодаря скоординированным усилиям американских военных и наших союзников по Персидскому заливу, средний семидневный объем нефти, выходящей из Ормузского пролива, в настоящее время достигает почти 9 миллионов баррелей в день. В сочетании с дополнительными 5-7 миллионами баррелей в день, покидающими регион по недавно модернизированным трубопроводам и экспортным объектам, общий поток нефти в настоящее время составляет в среднем около 15 миллионов баррелей в день.  Только в воскресенье из региона Персидского залива было вывезено более 20 миллионов баррелей, что превышает средний показатель до начала конфликта.
items.original_title: RT by @WhiteHouse: Thanks to the coordinated efforts of the U.S. military and our gulf allies, the seven-day average for oil leaving the Strait of Hormuz is currently up to almost 9 million barrels per day. When combined with the additional 5-7 million barrels per day leaving the region via newly upgraded pipelines and export facilities, total oil flows are currently averaging approximately 15 million barrels per day.  On Sunday alone, over 20 million barrels left the Arabian gulf region, which is above the pre-conflict average.
